Quad.R Design Pte Ltd
Advertiser: Quad.R Interior Design
Started: 22 Apr 2026
For Madam Ge, art is not merely decoration. It is a
representation of life’s journey - the struggles, and the
beauty, which make it all much more meaningful. Hence, her
home needed to be more than a gallery where art was simply
admired. It was designed to be an experience where art and
life was interwoven quietly, a serene exhibition of memories.
The House Of Recollections Designed by @nick_109sqft
